meta.siteDescription: Play free online games instantly in your browser. No downloads, no login. New games from indie developers every week on Brainstorming Games.

shell.greetingBody: Pick any game and it starts in your browser. No downloads, no login.

action.name: Action
action.intro: Fast reflexes, close calls and big finishes. Action games throw you straight into the moment: dodge, jump, fight and chase your best run. Every game here starts in your browser in seconds, on a phone or a PC.

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.intro: Explore new worlds one step at a time. Adventure games mix story, discovery and light puzzles, so there is always something around the next corner. Play free, with nothing to install.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.intro: Easy to learn, hard to put down. Arcade games are built for quick sessions and high scores, perfect for a short break. Tap play and chase one more run.

puzzle.name: Puzzle
puzzle.intro: Give your brain a workout. From matching and merging to logic and physics, puzzle games reward a calm head and a clever idea. Play at your own pace, free in your browser.

racing-driving.name: Racing & Driving
racing-driving.intro: Start your engine. Race cars and bikes, drift through corners or just enjoy the drive. These racing and driving games run instantly, with no download.

shooting.name: Shooting
shooting.intro: Take aim and stay sharp. Shooting games test your accuracy and timing across targets, arenas and waves. All of them are suitable for ages 12 and up.

sports.name: Sports
sports.intro: Cricket, football, basketball and more. Sports games bring quick matches and friendly rivalry to your browser. Play a full game in minutes.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.intro: Think two moves ahead. Build, defend, plan and outsmart. Strategy games reward patience and a good plan more than fast fingers.

simulation.name: Simulation
simulation.intro: Run a shop, fly a plane or build a city. Simulation games let you try a role and see what happens when you make the calls.

clicker-idle.name: Clicker & Idle
clicker-idle.intro: Tap, upgrade, repeat. Clicker and idle games grow while you play and keep growing in the background, so every visit has a new upgrade waiting.

io.name: .io
io.intro: Drop into an arena with players from around the world. .io games are simple to start and competitive within seconds.

card-board.name: Card & Board
card-board.intro: Ludo, carrom, chess, solitaire and other table classics. Card and board games are the easiest way to play something familiar, alone or with a friend.

word-trivia.name: Word & Trivia
word-trivia.intro: Find the word, beat the quiz. Word and trivia games are quick, clever and great for learning something new.

2-player.name: 2-Player
2-player.intro: Better with a friend. These games let two people play on the same device or join each other online. Start a party and send the link.

made-in-india.name: Made in India
made-in-india.intro: Games built by studios and solo developers from India. Play something made close to home and support the people who made it.

footer.label: Footer
footer.tagline: Free games. Zero downloads. Play in one tap.

dashboard.noGamesBody: Upload an HTML5 or WebGL build, add covers and a description, and our pre-QA bot checks it in minutes.

wizard.title: Title
wizard.shortDescriptionHint: One sentence for tiles and search results.
wizard.tagsHint: Type a tag and press comma or Enter. At least 3, up to {count}.
wizard.exclusive: Offer a 90-day web-exclusive window after Rise Launch (80% share)
wizard.madeInIndiaHint: Show this game in the Made in India collection on the player site.
wizard.controlsHint: Add each thing a player does, then pick the key or touch that does it. At least one.
wizard.more: More for the game page (features, tips, FAQ)
wizard.ownsRights: I made this game or have the rights to publish all of it: code, art, music and sounds.
wizard.noCopies: It is not a copy or clone of another game and does not use other games' names, characters or logos.
wizard.creditsHint: List any assets you did not make (asset packs, fonts, music) and their licence, e.g. "Kenney sprites, CC0".

wizard.checkPreQa: A build that passed the automatic checks
wizard.afterSubmit: After you submit, an automatic check looks for copied builds, copied covers, protected names and outside ad code. Then a person on our team plays the game and approves it, usually within 3 working days.

media.intro: Covers show the game title only: no "Play now" or "New" badges, no borders, no store logos.
media.videoSpec: 15 to 30 seconds, up to 50 MB, MP4 or WebM

media.abBody: Not sure which cover gets more clicks? Upload one or two other versions of your landscape cover. Players see one of them at random, and after each has been shown 1,000 times the cover that more people clicked becomes your main cover automatically. Players just see a normal cover; they never know a test is running.

payouts.intro: Statements are published each month. Payouts are sent about 45 days after the month ends, from {inr} or {usd}; smaller balances roll over.
payouts.noProfile: Add your payout details so we can pay you.
payouts.encrypted: Encrypted before it is stored. Only our finance team can read it, and only to send a payout.
payouts.noStatements: No statements yet. They appear after your first month with ads (Rise Launch).

growth.abIntro: Upload two or more landscape covers (A, B, C) in the game editor. Each visitor sees one of them. When every cover has {count, number} impressions, the cover with the best click rate becomes your only cover.
growth.abNone: No test running. Add a second cover to start one.
growth.playtestIntro: During Spark Launch, players who joined the playtest panel answer three questions about your game.

discovery.title: Brain Rank
discovery.intro: Brain Rank is how the site decides which games get the best shelf space. It rewards games people click, keep playing and come back to. It cannot be bought.
discovery.exploring: Exploration: {count, number} more guaranteed impressions before the numbers alone decide.
discovery.explored: Exploration finished: the score now rests on how players respond.
discovery.funnelTitle: From impression to a real play

database.nearLimit: The database is over 80% of the plan limit. Old events are the first thing to archive; see docs/DATABASE.md.
database.pgadminBody: The live database is plain PostgreSQL, so pgAdmin connects to it directly with the connection details from the database host. The guide lists the steps and the useful queries.

admin.notAllowedHowMock: On this machine, add your e-mail to NEXT_PUBLIC_OWNER_EMAILS in the .env.local file, restart, and sign in again.

owner.title: Enter your owner code
owner.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Brainstorming Games.
owner.setupIntro: The management portal needs a second lock that only you hold: a code from an app on your phone.
owner.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
owner.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this code.
owner.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:
owner.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
owner.wrong: That code is not right. Codes change every 30 seconds: try the current one.
owner.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
owner.unavailable: The code could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
owner.note: The portal stays unlocked for this browser session. Never share the code or the set-up key.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.intro: Paid Boosts to fulfil. Make the videos, post them on the official channels, then paste the links here: the studio is e-mailed straight away.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Memberships and Boosts. Razorpay is the record of truth; refunds are made from the Razorpay dashboard.

emails.title: Automated e-mails
emails.intro: Every e-mail the site sent, from the official address. A personal Gmail account sends up to about 100 a day.

autoReview.title: Automatic moderation
autoReview.intro: Runs the moment a game is submitted, before a person looks at it. It compares the build and covers with every other studio's games, looks for protected names and outside ad code, and checks the rights declaration. A person still has to play the game and look at the art before approving.

boost.intro: Get your game in front of more players. We make short videos of your game and post them on the official Brainstorming Games YouTube and Instagram, and your game gets a sponsored slot on the site.
